assertion_independence: No literal identity assertion comparing an unchanged supplied value to itself was found. The algebraic target/projection checks compare computed solutions with independently fixed matrices and expected coefficients. The physical residual assertion at line 928 has a shared-instrument weakness: rows are supplied by the same _evaluate used to predict them; the blocking finding names the untested conductor-observation omission that survives this arrangement.

failure_delta_positive_control: Both log parsers saw the known-present test_the_solve_defaults_to_the_root_find failure; the head log also records three nonzero initial errors and three RECOVERY rows, so an empty added set is a measured set difference, not an empty parser output.

findings.text: blocking: The physical gate creates sensor targets through MagneticsFit._evaluate using _PlasmaDiagnosticSource, whose only currents are terminal plasma cells (lines 420-467), and sets measurement.vacuum to zero (line 640); prescribed-conductor fields therefore never participate in either the recovery observations or the displaced-geometry control, so the recorded passes do not establish the required synthetic-magnetics endpoint with prescribed conductors, and a conductor-observation omission would survive every added physical assertion; synthesize total observations independently through the existing kernels, or explicitly validate the known-conductor subtraction at both the nominal and displaced sensor geometry, then record the same unchanged threshold checks.
